name: Toast Quest aka I'm not feeling myself today
source:
Bertie's alarm woke him up early. He starts craving toast, so he puts some bread in the toaster. After taking a quick bathroom break, he returns to find the toaster empty. He sets out on an emotional adventure looking for what happened to it.

[From [url=https://nickrowler.itch.io/toast-quest-aka]itch.io[/url]]
